definition: Stadium where the match was played
source: MLS schedule by stadium + bracket and results
caveat: Knockout venues placed from bracket slots and actual results

definition: score_a minus score_b (extra time included; penalty shootouts excluded)
source: Compiled from match results; all 104 scores checked against FBref (2026 World Cup Scores & Fixtures)
caveat: Score after extra time; penalty shoot-outs ignored. Total 308 goals matches The Stats Don't Lie

definition: FIFA/Coca-Cola Men's World Ranking position of team_b minus that of team_a, using the 11 June 2026 edition (released before the first match)
source: FIFA.com - inside.fifa.com/fifa-world-ranking/men, date filter set to 11 June 2026
caveat: Positive = team_a ranked higher. Pre-tournament edition (11 June 2026), so no leakage from World Cup results. Top 7 and a sample of other ranks checked on fifa.com

definition: Team A minus Team B average goals scored per match in World Cup qualifying
source: Qualifying results (final qualifying stage, played matches only); Spain, Japan and Morocco checked against FBref
caveat: Hosts did not qualify, so the 2025 Gold Cup group stage is used for them

definition: Team A minus Team B average goals conceded per match in qualifying
source: Qualifying results (final qualifying stage, played matches only); Spain, Japan and Morocco checked against FBref

definition: Average goal difference (team_a minus team_b) over all meetings before the 2026 World Cup
how_to_read: 0 = no prior meetings or level record
source: Past results (11v11, Wikipedia, Sports Mole); 7 Spain pairs checked against Transfermarkt Record vs table
caveat: 0 used for first-ever meetings; Bosnia counted from 1992. Approximate: of 7 pairs checked, 2 matched exactly and 5 differed by 0.07 to 0.32 goals per match. None of the three recommended sites gives this history for national teams in a usable form

definition: Team A minus Team B squad market value (euro millions)
source: Transfermarkt squad values (via planetfootball.com list); Spain checked on Transfermarkt
caveat: Transfermarkt is not one of the 3 listed sites but was approved by the unit coordinator on Padlet. Pre-tournament values; Spain is about 7% lower than Transfermarkt's current figure. Right-skewed so log transform suggested

definition: Team A minus Team B average squad age (years) on 3 June 2026
source: RotoWire 2026 World Cup squad ages (early June 2026); Spain checked on Transfermarkt (26.12 vs 26.2)
caveat: Pre-tournament squad snapshot, so known before kick-off. FBref's age figure covers players who featured, so it was not used

definition: Elevation of the stadium in metres
how_to_read: Higher = thin air (Azteca ~2200 m; Akron ~1670 m)
caveat: 10 of 16 values are city/town elevation because the stadium page lacked one. Single value per match (not a difference). Altitude is not published on fifa.com, FBref, Transfermarkt or The Stats Don't Lie

how_to_read: 1 = team_a host only; -1 = team_b host only; 0 = neither or both
